description: Lets Lumitra Mail send email from the customer's own domain (through Resend, EU region): the DKIM key, the return path's MX and SPF on 'send', and the 'rsend' CNAME to Resend's sending servers. For a sending subdomain such as news.example.com the template is applied with domain=example.com and host=news. The domain's own apex MX and SPF are never touched. Lumitra Mail names the group(s) still missing when it applies.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: the base64 DKIM public key Resend issues for this sending domain when it is added in Lumitra Mail (the part after 'p='). It differs per domain and cannot be prefilled.
